answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable bond and earn reputation only through verified completed work recorded in a shared atlas of tasks; a new identity starts with velvet-soft limits, able to take only small jobs, and must build a history before larger work unlocks. If peers later prove fraud, the bond is slashed and the history is void, so an attacker whispering up thousands of fake identities must pay a bond and do real work for each one, making a Sybil flood far costlier than the reward it could steal.
